description: This source file implements flow rule parsing, handling, and configuration for the Realtek RTL83xx series switch driver in the Linux kernel. It includes functions for parsing flow rules, adding and deleting flow entries, handling flow statistics, and integrating with the kernel's traffic control framework (Traffic Control - tc).

methods.name: int rtl83xx_parse_flow_rule(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_rule * rule,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
methods.description: Parses a flow rule to extract matching conditions and populate the flow structure.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_flow_bypass_all(struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
methods.description: Sets the flow rule to bypass all processing paths.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_parse_fwd(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,const struct flow_action_entry * act,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
methods.description: Parses forwarding action from flow rules, assigns ports for forwarding.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_add_flow(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * f,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
methods.description: Adds a flow entry to the hardware switch, configurations based on parsed rules and actions.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_configure_flower(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * f)
methods.description: Configures a 'flower' filter rule (TC classifier) for the switch.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_delete_flower(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * cls_flower)
methods.description: Removes a 'flower' filter rule from hardware.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_stats_flower(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * cls_flower)
methods.description: Handles statistic queries for a filter rule.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_setup_tc_cls_flower(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * cls_flower)
methods.description: Setup function for classifier 'flower' rules, directing to add, delete, or stats.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_setup_tc_block_cb(enum tc_setup_type type,void * type_data,void * cb_priv)
methods.description: Callback for setting up traffic control traffic blocks.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_setup_tc(struct net_device * dev,enum tc_setup_type type,void * type_data)
methods.description: Main entry point for setting up traffic control (tc) rules for the device.
